items.exampleEn: The findings of the study surprised everyone.
items.exampleZh: 這項研究的發現讓大家很驚訝。

items.exampleEn: He grabbed his bag and ran to the bus.
items.exampleZh: 他抓起包包，跑去趕公車。

items.exampleEn: I intend to finish this book by Sunday.
items.exampleZh: 我打算在星期天前看完這本書。

items.exampleEn: She gave a small nod and smiled.
items.exampleZh: 她輕輕點了個頭，笑了笑。

items.exampleEn: The company plans to expand into Japan next year.
items.exampleZh: 公司計畫明年把業務拓展到日本。

items.exampleEn: Tall buildings surround the small park.
items.exampleZh: 高樓圍繞著這座小公園。

items.exampleEn: Our school adopted a new way of teaching English.
items.exampleZh: 我們學校採用了一種新的英文教學方式。

items.exampleEn: Connect the printer to your computer first.
items.exampleZh: 先把印表機連接到你的電腦。

items.sentenceEn: The hotel is surrounded by beautiful gardens.
items.sentenceZh: 這家飯店被美麗的花園圍繞著。

items.audioEn: When I asked if he was ready, he answered with a nod.
items.audioZh: 我問他準備好了沒，他點頭回答。

items.sentenceEn: They adopted a cat from the animal shelter last year.
items.sentenceZh: 他們去年從動物收容所收養了一隻貓。

items.sentenceEn: Can you connect me to the sales department, please?
items.sentenceZh: 可以幫我轉接業務部嗎？

items.stemEn: It's raining, so ____ an umbrella before you go out.
items.stemZh: 在下雨，出門前拿把傘吧。

items.stemEn: We ____ to visit Kyoto next spring.
items.stemZh: 我們打算明年春天去京都。

items.passageEn: A recent study about city parks had an interesting finding: people who live near parks surrounded by trees feel less stressed. Because of this, our city intends to expand the green areas downtown. It will also adopt a new plan to connect small parks with bike paths. At a meeting last week, the mayor read the report and gave a nod of approval. Work on the first path will start in May.
items.passageZh: 最近一項關於城市公園的研究有個有趣的發現：住在被樹木圍繞的公園附近的人，壓力比較小。因此，我們的城市打算擴大市中心的綠地。市政府也會採用新的計畫，用腳踏車道把小公園連接起來。上星期開會時，市長看了報告，點頭表示同意。第一條車道五月開工。

options: 城市裡的公園實在是太少了
很多人不喜歡騎腳踏車
公園附近的房子價格比較貴
住在綠地公園旁的人壓力小

questions.questionZh: 城市打算怎麼把小公園連接起來？

items.promptZh: 我本來不打算買這麼多東西。
referenceEn: I didn't intend to buy so many things.
I did not intend to buy so much.
rubricZh: intend to＋原形動詞，表示「打算」
「本來不打算」用過去式否定（例如 didn't intend）
「這麼多東西」可寫 so many things、so much 等

items.promptZh: 那個男孩是在三歲時被收養的。
referenceEn: The boy was adopted when he was three.
That boy was adopted at the age of three.
rubricZh: 用 adopt 表示「收養」，這裡用被動（例如 was adopted）
「三歲時」可寫，例如 when he was three、at the age of three、at three 等
